lec02np-frame-u01.name: lec02np-frame-u01
lec02np-frame-u01.text: 形狀由資料密集程度決定

lec02np-u01-1-title.name: lec02np-u01-1-title
lec02np-u01-1-title.text: 密集程度畫出密度形狀

lec02np-u01-1-body.name: lec02np-u01-1-body
lec02np-u01-1-body.text:
不先挑高斯家族；直接讀取樣本分布。
少放形狀假設，就需要更多資料。

lec02np-u01-1-english.name: lec02np-u01-1-english
lec02np-u01-1-english.text: Parametric: choose a family. Nonparametric: let local crowding determine the shape.

lec02np-u01-2-title.name: lec02np-u01-2-title
lec02np-u01-2-title.text: 無母數仍需假設與選擇

lec02np-u01-2-body.name: lec02np-u01-2-body
lec02np-u01-2-body.text:
✗ 無母數不是完全沒有假設。
✓ 樣本仍須獨立同分布，仍要選平滑程度。

lec02np-u01-2-english.name: lec02np-u01-2-english
lec02np-u01-2-english.text: Assume i.i.d. samples; choose a bin width or bandwidth. No prescribed density form does not mean zero choices.

lec02np-u01-3-body.name: lec02np-u01-3-body
lec02np-u01-3-body.text:
參數法像修改現成衣服；無母數像用布捏形狀。
更自由、更吃布；手抖的凸起就像雜訊。

lec02np-u01-3-english.name: lec02np-u01-3-english
lec02np-u01-3-english.text: Tailoring a ready-made size versus moulding cloth: freer shapes consume more data and inherit noise.

lec02np-u02-1-english.name: lec02np-u02-1-english
lec02np-u02-1-english.text: Count samples, normalize to probability, then divide by bin width.

lec02np-u02-2-body.name: lec02np-u02-2-body
lec02np-u02-2-body.text:
b：格寬；N：總數；k_N：所在格點數。
機率是 k_N/N；密度再除以格寬。

lec02np-u02-2-english.name: lec02np-u02-2-english
lec02np-u02-2-english.text: Probability = density × width. The histogram is constant inside each bin.

lec02np-u02-3-title.name: lec02np-u02-3-title
lec02np-u02-3-title.text: 收斂需要三條件同時成立

lec02np-u02-3-body.name: lec02np-u02-3-body
lec02np-u02-3-body.text:
格寬趨零；每格點數趨無限；每格占比趨零。
樣本數須成長得比解析度快。

lec02np-u02-3-english.name: lec02np-u02-3-english
lec02np-u02-3-english.text: All conditions hold together: finer bins, more points per bin, and a vanishing share per bin.

lec02np-u02-4-title.name: lec02np-u02-4-title
lec02np-u02-4-title.text: 格數須比樣本數成長慢

lec02np-u02-4-english.name: lec02np-u02-4-english
lec02np-u02-4-english.text: With m bins, average count = N/m. Finer is not always better: counts of 0 or 1 produce noisy spikes.

lec02np-u03-1-title.name: lec02np-u03-1-title
lec02np-u03-1-title.text: 粗格抹平而細格放大雜訊

lec02np-u03-1-body.name: lec02np-u03-1-body
lec02np-u03-1-body.text:
同一批200點：4格太粗；8格呈雙峰；60格尖刺。
真密度是兩個等權高斯混合。

lec02np-u03-1-english.name: lec02np-u03-1-english
lec02np-u03-1-english.text: True density: 0.5 N(-1.5, 0.4²) + 0.5 N(1.5, 0.5²). Wider bins raise bias; narrower bins raise variance.

lec02np-u03-2-body.name: lec02np-u03-2-body
lec02np-u03-2-body.text:
60格：每格點數少，變異大。
4格：格內變化被壓平，偏誤大。
軟體預設不是資料的最佳格數。

lec02np-u03-2-english.name: lec02np-u03-2-english
lec02np-u03-2-english.text: Bias–variance trade-off: software defaults are conventions, not an optimum.

lec02np-u03-3-title.name: lec02np-u03-3-title
lec02np-u03-3-title.text: 四分位距給出格寬起點

lec02np-u03-3-english.name: lec02np-u03-3-english
lec02np-u03-3-english.text: Freedman–Diaconis accounts for sample size and spread; it is a starting point, not a guarantee.

lec02np-u04-1-title.name: lec02np-u04-1-title
lec02np-u04-1-title.text: 核須非負且總面積為一

lec02np-u04-1-body.name: lec02np-u04-1-body
lec02np-u04-1-body.text:
方框b=1.0，高1.0；高斯峰約0.40、尾巴較長。
平滑核把階梯换成圓肩。

lec02np-u04-1-english.name: lec02np-u04-1-english
lec02np-u04-1-english.text: A kernel is nonnegative and integrates to one. Each sample is the centre of a small bump.

lec02np-u04-2-title.name: lec02np-u04-2-title
lec02np-u04-2-title.text: 窗寬縮放後再平均核值

lec02np-u04-2-body.name: lec02np-u04-2-body
lec02np-u04-2-body.text:
x：估計位置；x_i：樣本；l：維度。
b：窗寬；φ：核。除以b^l維持總面積。

lec02np-u04-2-english.name: lec02np-u04-2-english
lec02np-u04-2-english.text: Scale sample distances by b, average kernel values, then normalize by b^l.

lec02np-u04-3-body.name: lec02np-u04-3-body
lec02np-u04-3-body.text:
✗ 核形狀是最重要的選擇。
✓ 實務上窗寬影響較大。高斯核平滑且好處理。

lec02np-u04-3-english.name: lec02np-u04-3-english
lec02np-u04-3-english.text: Kernel shape usually has a smaller effect than bandwidth. The Gaussian is convenient, not uniquely correct.

lec02np-u05-1-title.name: lec02np-u05-1-title
lec02np-u05-1-title.text: 小窗寬留下高變異尖刺

lec02np-u05-1-body.name: lec02np-u05-1-body
lec02np-u05-1-body.text:
N=80、b=0.05：RMS=0.091。
小b：低偏誤、高變異；只反映局部樣本。

lec02np-u05-1-english.name: lec02np-u05-1-english
lec02np-u05-1-english.text: A tiny bandwidth makes each kernel a needle and shows noise rather than stable structure.

lec02np-u05-2-title.name: lec02np-u05-2-title
lec02np-u05-2-title.text: 中等窗寬保留清楚雙峰

lec02np-u05-2-english.name: lec02np-u05-2-english
lec02np-u05-2-english.text: An intermediate bandwidth balances error; a large bandwidth has high bias and low variance.

lec02np-u05-3-title.name: lec02np-u05-3-title
lec02np-u05-3-title.text: 大窗寬會抹平真實細節

lec02np-u05-3-body.name: lec02np-u05-3-body
lec02np-u05-3-body.text:
b=1.20：附近樣本被糊在一起。
雜訊與失真拉鋸，窗寬就是繩子。

lec02np-u05-3-english.name: lec02np-u05-3-english
lec02np-u05-3-english.text: Noise and distortion pull against each other, and bandwidth is the rope.

lec02np-u05-4-title.name: lec02np-u05-4-title
lec02np-u05-4-title.text: 更多資料讓最佳窗寬縮小

lec02np-u05-4-body.name: lec02np-u05-4-body
lec02np-u05-4-body.text:
N從80增至320：最佳b從0.26移至0.17。
最佳值只適用示範資料，不是通用常數。

lec02np-u05-4-english.name: lec02np-u05-4-english
lec02np-u05-4-english.text: More samples fill each other in, reducing overall error and the need for smoothing.

lec02np-u06-1-title.name: lec02np-u06-1-title
lec02np-u06-1-title.text: 五個樣本各自貢獻一顆核

lec02np-u06-1-english.name: lec02np-u06-1-english
lec02np-u06-1-english.text: Each sample contributes a Gaussian kernel. Here l = 1, so the normalization is 1/b.

lec02np-u06-2-title.name: lec02np-u06-2-title
lec02np-u06-2-title.text: 核值總和除五得到密度

lec02np-u06-2-english.name: lec02np-u06-2-english
lec02np-u06-2-english.text: Python-computed values: p-hat(0) ≈ 0.196. Averaging, not an unnormalized sum, produces the density.

lec02np-u06-3-body.name: lec02np-u06-3-body
lec02np-u06-3-body.text:
方框b=1.0只納入−0.5、0.5兩點。
同樣五點：高斯0.196，方框0.400。
密度不是機率，不能把峰高當上限。

lec02np-u06-3-english.name: lec02np-u06-3-english
lec02np-u06-3-english.text: The box example includes both boundary points. Changing only the kernel changes the estimate.

lec02np-u06-4-english.name: lec02np-u06-4-english
lec02np-u06-4-english.text: Repeat the table at x = 1.0. Average the five kernel values and apply the bandwidth normalization.

lec02np-frame-u07.name: lec02np-frame-u07
lec02np-frame-u07.text: 固定點數讓體積自動伸縮

lec02np-u07-1-body.name: lec02np-u07-1-body
lec02np-u07-1-body.text:
指定k，再把體積擴到剛好包住k點。
密處體積小；疏處體積大。

lec02np-u07-1-english.name: lec02np-u07-1-english
lec02np-u07-1-english.text: Where the fish are dense, a small net catches enough of them.

lec02np-u07-2-body.name: lec02np-u07-2-body
lec02np-u07-2-body.text:
k：指定點數；N：總樣本數。
V(x)：包住k樣本的最小體積。
V不必是超球；立方體、橢球也可一致使用。

lec02np-u07-2-english.name: lec02np-u07-2-english
lec02np-u07-2-english.text: Density is the normalized count per unit volume. Use a consistent volume definition.

lec02np-u07-3-title.name: lec02np-u07-3-title
lec02np-u07-3-title.text: 固定體積與固定點數相對照

lec02np-u07-3-body.name: lec02np-u07-3-body
lec02np-u07-3-body.text:
Parzen：固定窗寬與體積，點數可變。
kNN：固定點數k，體積隨密度伸縮。

lec02np-u07-3-english.name: lec02np-u07-3-english
lec02np-u07-3-english.text: Parzen fixes volume and varies the enclosed count; kNN fixes the count and varies volume.

lec02np-frame-u08.name: lec02np-frame-u08
lec02np-frame-u08.text: 體積比與樣本數比決定類別

lec02np-u08-1-title.name: lec02np-u08-1-title
lec02np-u08-1-title.text: 體積比仍須考慮先驗代價

lec02np-u08-1-body.name: lec02np-u08-1-body
lec02np-u08-1-body.text:
V_i：各類包住k點的體積；N_i：類樣本數。
P(ω_i)：先驗；λ_ij：真j判i的代價。

lec02np-u08-1-english.name: lec02np-u08-1-english
lec02np-u08-1-english.text: Compare class-conditional density estimates. Unequal counts, priors and costs change the threshold.

lec02np-u08-2-title.name: lec02np-u08-2-title
lec02np-u08-2-title.text: 半徑減半面積變成四分之一

lec02np-u08-2-english.name: lec02np-u08-2-english
lec02np-u08-2-english.text: Class 2 encloses five neighbours with radius rho; class 1 needs radius 2 rho and four times the area.

lec02np-u08-3-body.name: lec02np-u08-3-body
lec02np-u08-3-body.text:
V₂/V₁=0.25；N₁/N₂≈0.967。
0.25<0.967，所以判ω₂。
不必真的算密度；類不平衡不可只看體積。

lec02np-u08-3-english.name: lec02np-u08-3-english
lec02np-u08-3-english.text: Compare volumes with the count ratio, under the example threshold. Density terms often cancel.

lec02np-u08-4-body.name: lec02np-u08-4-body
lec02np-u08-4-body.text:
若k從5改成3，兩個半徑如何變？
提示：圓縮小，密度比大致不變，邊界也移動。

lec02np-u08-4-english.name: lec02np-u08-4-english
lec02np-u08-4-english.text: Practice: reason about the two radii and the decision boundary without computing a new answer.

lec02np-frame-u09.name: lec02np-frame-u09
lec02np-frame-u09.text: 高維讓附近樣本變得稀少

lec02np-u09-1-title.name: lec02np-u09-1-title
lec02np-u09-1-title.text: 百億點仍無法填滿高維

lec02np-u09-1-english.name: lec02np-u09-1-english
lec02np-u09-1-english.text: The lecture analytic distance model shows that adding dimensions empties the space.

lec02np-u09-2-title.name: lec02np-u09-2-title
lec02np-u09-2-title.text: 千倍樣本對高維幫助有限

lec02np-u09-2-body.name: lec02np-u09-2-body
lec02np-u09-2-body.text:
N從10⁷增到10¹⁰：
2維距離縮短31.6倍；40維僅1.19倍。
這是幾何稀疏，不是浮點誤差。

lec02np-u09-2-english.name: lec02np-u09-2-english
lec02np-u09-2-english.text: More data rescue low-dimensional problems but barely touch high-dimensional ones.

lec02np-u09-3-body.name: lec02np-u09-3-body
lec02np-u09-3-body.text:
3000均勻點到中心距離：比較2、10、40維。
40維集中在√(40/12)≈1.83附近。
中心距離分布不等於最近鄰距離分布。

lec02np-u09-3-english.name: lec02np-u09-3-english
lec02np-u09-3-english.text: The lower figure measures distance from the cube centre. Concentration illustrates the geometric difficulty.

lec02np-u09-4-title.name: lec02np-u09-4-title
lec02np-u09-4-title.text: 先減少維度再估計密度

lec02np-u09-4-body.name: lec02np-u09-4-body
lec02np-u09-4-body.text: 硬上高維會產生孤立尖峰，分類器只記住樣本。

lec02np-u09-4-english.name: lec02np-u09-4-english
lec02np-u09-4-english.text: PCA or feature selection reduces l before applying Parzen or kNN.

lec02np-u09-5-title.name: lec02np-u09-5-title
lec02np-u09-5-title.text: 平滑程度與資料量一起選

lec02np-u09-5-body.name: lec02np-u09-5-body
lec02np-u09-5-body.text:
無母數不預設密度形式，代價是更多資料。
格寬與窗寬平衡偏誤、變異；高維先減維。

lec02np-u09-5-english.name: lec02np-u09-5-english
lec02np-u09-5-english.text: Histogram: count / (N × width). Parzen: average scaled kernels. kNN: count / (N × volume).

lec02np-u09-6-title.name: lec02np-u09-6-title
lec02np-u09-6-title.text: 掌握中英術語連結方法

lec02np-u09-6-body.name: lec02np-u09-6-body
lec02np-u09-6-body.text:
參數法／無母數；直方圖／格寬；偏誤／變異。
核／窗寬；體積比／概似比；維度詛咒／最近鄰。

lec02np-u09-6-english.name: lec02np-u09-6-english
lec02np-u09-6-english.text: Parametric / nonparametric; histogram / bin width; bias / variance; kernel / bandwidth; RMS error; kNN; volume ratio / likelihood ratio; curse of dimensionality; nearest-neighbour distance; IQR. Reading: Pattern Recognition, 4th ed., Ch. 2 §2.5.

metadata.title: 圖型識別 第2週｜無母數密度估計
